# R3 offline fixtures

`data-games.pgn`: three unmodified mainlines/headers exported with python-chess
from the frozen Lichess January 2017 prefix, CC0-1.0. Source game links remain
in Site headers: Z5NSdZX4, YTmM2vw0, jqGTCKta. Formatting is normalized by the
exporter; these are real games, not generated training labels. Used for small,
deterministic offline CI checks; the formal dataset is separately hashed.
